Specification:

aiTexts: The R36S Retro Handheld Game Console features a 3.5-inch IPS screen with 680x480 resolution for clear, vivid visuals and reduced eye fatigue.
Powered by a professional RK3326 1.5GHz 64-bit chip, it smoothly runs over 15,000 retro games across 21 emulators.
Its 64GB storage offers ample space for your favorite games, while a built-in 2900mAh battery provides up to 4 hours of continuous play.
Compact and portable with dual joysticks and upgraded L/R buttons, it’s ideal for gaming anytime, anywhere.
Supports OTG output to connect to larger screens for enhanced viewing.

title: Super Mini 821 Classic TV Game Console
detail_text: If you’re of a certain age, you probably have fond memories of handheld video game systems. The technology has changed a lot, but gaming consoles remain as popular as ever, thanks to both a wave of nostalgia and an increased demand for portable play and connectivity. The SN-02 is a powerful, emulation-based system that can handle games up to 8bit, and looks and feels great. What really sets the SN-02 apart is the fact that it boasts 2 comfortable controllers. Simple arcade style and easy to play. A perfect companion to promote our kids’ eyehand coordination abilities. The game console is a newly released product for children’s plug-and-play handheld game consoles. Which can bring more outstanding gaming experiences to game lovers. The style look looks very popular with children. Your child will love it. Connect to the TV and your whole family can enjoy up to 821 games.

title: New GUSGU H7 Open Source Handheld Game Console Linux 64Bit System 4.5" IPS Screen Portable Pocket Video Games Player 4000mAh
detail_text: H7 handheld game console product introduction 1. About the game: Supports over 30 classic platform emulators The game console is equipped with a deeply optimized 64 bit Linux open-source operating system and a quad core processor (with a clock speed of 1.5GHz), which can run more than 20 platform games such as PSP, PS1, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast, N64, NDS, GBA, GBC, SFC, FC, MAME, etc. 2. Regarding the Screen: 4.5-inch Full Fit IPS HD Screen A 4.5-inch IPS display screen with a resolution of up to 1024 × 768 and fully covered tempered glass effectively eliminates pixel blurring and screen separation. Clear and sharp images take you back to childhood memories. 3. Regarding the battery: 4000mAh battery, 3-6 hours of continuous use The game console is equipped with a 4000mAh high-capacity battery, designed specifically for 24/7 gaming. The Type-C interface supports fast charging and can be fully charged in about 2 hours. Tested in the laboratory, the battery life can last up to 3-6 hours, allowing you to play smoothly and have longer gaming time. 4. Product appearance: Ergonomic design, paired with RGB breathing light The game console has been carefully designed by top designers and has a classic handheld feel that top players love. The high-precision 3D joystick brings a smooth and sensitive control experience. More cool RGB breathing light effects create an immersive gaming atmosphere 5. Regarding storage: Built in 4GB storage, supports up to 1TB TF card expansion The game console is equipped with 1GB of RAM and 4GB of ROM, which can be expanded through a TF card and supports up to 1TB. The 64GB TF card can accommodate around 20000 games; A 128GB TF card can accommodate around 40000 games.

H7 handheld game console product introduction



1. About the game: Supports over 30 classic platform emulators


The game console is equipped with a deeply optimized 64 bit Linux open-source operating system and a quad core processor (with a clock speed of 1.5GHz), which can run more than 20 platform games such as PSP, PS1, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast, N64, NDS, GBA, GBC, SFC, FC, MAME, etc.


2. Regarding the Screen: 4.5-inch Full Fit IPS HD Screen


A 4.5-inch IPS display screen with a resolution of up to 1024 × 768 and fully covered tempered glass effectively eliminates pixel blurring and screen separation. Clear and sharp images take you back to childhood memories.


3. Regarding the battery: 4000mAh battery, 3-6 hours of continuous use


The game console is equipped with a 4000mAh high-capacity battery, designed specifically for 24/7 gaming. The Type-C interface supports fast charging and can be fully charged in about 2 hours. Tested in the laboratory, the battery life can last up to 3-6 hours, allowing you to play smoothly and have longer gaming time.


4. Product appearance: Ergonomic design, paired with RGB breathing light


The game console has been carefully designed by top designers and has a classic handheld feel that top players love. The high-precision 3D joystick brings a smooth and sensitive control experience. More cool RGB breathing light effects create an immersive gaming atmosphere


5. Regarding storage: Built in 4GB storage, supports up to 1TB TF card expansion


The game console is equipped with 1GB of RAM and 4GB of ROM, which can be expanded through a TF card and supports up to 1TB. The 64GB TF card can accommodate around 20000 games; A 128GB TF card can accommodate around 40000 games.

page_json.name: New GUSGU H7 Open Source Handheld Game Console Linux 64Bit System 4.5" IPS Screen Portable Pocket Video Games Player 4000mAh
page_json.description: H7 handheld game console product introduction1. About the game: Supports over 30 classic platform emulatorsThe game console is equipped with a deeply optimized 64 bit Linux open-source operating system and a quad core processor (with a clock speed of 1.5GHz), which can run more than 20 platform games such as PSP, PS1, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast, N64, NDS, GBA, GBC, SFC, FC, MAME, etc.2. Regarding the Screen: 4.5-inch Full Fit IPS HD ScreenA 4.5-inch IPS display screen with a resolution of up to 1024 × 768 and fully covered tempered glass effectively eliminates pixel blurring and screen separation. Clear and sharp images take you back to childhood memories.3. Regarding the battery: 4000mAh battery, 3-6 hours of continuous useThe game console is equipped with a 4000mAh high-capacity battery, designed specifically for 24/7 gaming. The Type-C interface supports fast charging and can be fully charged in about 2 hours. Tested in the laboratory, the battery life can last up to 3-6 hours, allowing you to play smoothly and have longer gaming time.4. Product appearance: Ergonomic design, paired with RGB breathing lightThe game console has been carefully designed by top designers and has a classic handheld feel that top players love. The high-precision 3D joystick brings a smooth and sensitive control experience. More cool RGB breathing light effects create an immersive gaming atmosphere5. Regarding storage: Built in 4GB storage, supports up to 1TB TF card expansionThe game console is equipped with 1GB of RAM and 4GB of ROM, which can be expanded through a TF card and supports up to 1TB. The 64GB TF card can accommodate around 20000 games; A 128GB TF card can accommodate around 40000 games.
